source: CAS 79-09-4. C3 of the fatty-acid series. Geometric mean of the 6 measured (M) rows: 71 (Kim & Kim 2016), 15 (von Hartungen et al. 2004), 56 (Khan et al. 1995), 55 (Khan & Brimblecombe 1992), 61 (Servant et al. 1991), 22 (Butler & Ramchandani 1935). temp_dep 6800 K from Abraham (1984), type V. Note 489 on the Servant row: measured at a liquid-phase mixing ratio of 1 umol/mol, and the constant changes at higher concentrations.

CAS 107-92-6. C4. Geometric mean of the 5 measured (M) rows: 43 (Kim & Kim 2016), 9.7 (von Hartungen et al. 2004), 47 (Khan et al. 1995), 45 (Khan & Brimblecombe 1992), 18 (Butler & Ramchandani 1935). low/high span every listed type including QSPR. temp_dep 7100 K from Abraham (1984), type V; a second row gives 7300 K, type R.

CAS 109-52-4 (valeric acid). C5. Geometric mean of the 4 measured (M) rows: 24 (Kim & Kim 2016), 12 (von Hartungen et al. 2004), 23 (Khan et al. 1995), 21 (Khan & Brimblecombe 1992). temp_dep is the mean of the two M rows that carry one, 6600 and 6900 K, preferred over Abraham's 7500 K (type V) because these are measured.

CAS 142-62-1 (caproic acid). C6. Geometric mean of the 4 measured (M) rows: 9.9 (Kim & Kim 2016), 7.5 (von Hartungen et al. 2004), 13 (Khan et al. 1995), 13 (Khan & Brimblecombe 1992). temp_dep is the mean of the two M rows carrying one, 6300 and 5900 K; Staudinger & Roberts (2001), type L, independently gives 6100 K.

CAS 111-14-8 (enanthic acid). C7. ONE measured (M) row only: 15 (Kim & Kim 2016), so no spread between measurements is available and this value sits slightly above hexanoic, breaking the otherwise smooth decline across C3-C6. temp_dep 8500 K from Abraham (1984), type V, as no M row carries one.

CAS 124-07-2 (caprylic acid). C8. NO measured rows exist. Policy value is the geometric mean of the 4 vapour-pressure/solubility (V) rows: 11 (Duchowicz et al. 2020, note 187 = HENRYWIN quotient), 0.15 (Mackay et al. 2006c), 0.15 (Mackay et al. 1995), 7.6 (Brimblecombe et al. 1992). THOSE ROWS SPAN A FACTOR OF 73 AND THIS VALUE IS SUSPECT: it does not continue the measured C3-C7 decline. Dropping the two Mackay rows, which agree with each other and nothing else, gives 9.1, which does continue it. The policy value is kept rather than cherry-picked, but do not rest anything on C8. temp_dep 9600 K from Abraham (1984), type V.

CAS 112-05-0 (pelargonic acid; the page spells it pelargic). C9. NO measured rows exist. Geometric mean of the 2 vapour-pressure/solubility (V) rows: 6.1 (Duchowicz et al. 2020, note 187 = HENRYWIN quotient), 3.8 (Brimblecombe et al. 1992). No temperature coefficient published: the column is blank for every row, so no body-temperature correction is applied.

CAS 334-48-5 (capric acid). C10. NO measured rows exist and only ONE vapour-pressure/solubility (V) row: 7.4 (Duchowicz et al. 2020, note 187 = HENRYWIN quotient), so there is no spread within the chosen type either. A citation (C) row gives 6.5 (Hilal et al. 2008). No temperature coefficient published. Weakest entry in the acid series.

CAS 3658-80-8. Geometric mean of the 2 measured (M) rows: 1.4e-2 (Souchon et al. 2004), 2.1e-2 (Roberts & Pollien 1997). low also takes in 1.2e-2 (Plyasunova et al. 2004, type L, group contribution). No temperature coefficient published.

CAS 104-55-2. NO measured rows exist. Geometric mean of the 2 vapour-pressure/solubility (V) rows: 2.8 (HSDB 2015), 1.4 (van Roon et al. 2005). The page names no isomer, while odour work usually means trans. temp_dep 6300 K from the van Roon row.

CAS 99-49-0, carvone. STEREOCHEMISTRY NOT SPECIFIED by the source (its InChIKey carries no stereo block) whereas the receptor data is for L-carvone; enantiomers should partition alike, but the match is nominal. Single QSPR (Q) row, 0.13 (HSDB 2015, calculated by the Meylan & Howard 1991 method). An ESTIMATE: no measurement exists in the compilation, so no range is given.

CAS 503-74-2 (3-methylbutanoic acid). BRANCHED C5, not part of the straight-chain series. Geometric mean of the 5 measured (M) rows: 27 (Kim & Kim 2016), 11 (von Hartungen et al. 2004), 12 (Khan et al. 1995), 12 (Khan & Brimblecombe 1992), 12 (Amoore & Buttery 1978). No temperature coefficient published.

CAS 111-88-6, 1-octanethiol, ASSUMED to be what M2OR calls 'Octanethiol'. NO measured rows exist. Value is the vapour-pressure/solubility (V) row of Yaws et al. (2003), whose note 805 states the water solubility was itself calculated from a boiling-point correlation and that no vapour-pressure references are given. low/high span 8 estimate/QSPR rows.
